text:
𝗢𝗩𝗘𝗥𝗧𝗢𝗡 𝟱-𝟭𝟮! 🔥🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿

Jamie Overton's career-best 5/12 bowled Australia out for 108 at the Gabba, their lowest T20I total at home.
England won by 7 wkts (DLS) and lead 2-1.

Best spell of the series? 👇
#AUSvENG #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗢𝗩𝗘𝗥𝗧𝗢𝗡 𝟱-𝟭𝟮! 🔥

👉 Gabba mein Jamie Overton ne 4 over mein 12 run dekar 5 wicket liye, career-best T20I figures
👉 Australia 16.5 over mein 108 par all out, ghar par unka sabse kam T20I score
👉 England ne baarish-hit match 7 wicket se (DLS) jeet kar series mein 2-1 ki lead li

Is series ka ab tak ka sabse behtareen spell kiska raha?

#CricketKiBaat #AUSvENG #Cricket
